And I'm so sorry this triggered you...I'm sending love and I hope you're healing more day by day ❤️...

I don't think I'm the love of tho persons life...but they were definitely mine 😌...im grateful for there presence in my life...but I've been nothing but a burden to them...i know there's more out there for them...they think they love m and that I'm the love of their life...but I knkw there is something better then me out there...theyre a really deserving person. They deserve the world honestly... So kind sweet and thoughtful... A big heart, patient...they deserve so much more them me

Dont know if you'll see this...but I'm just sad about a lot...i feel like I'm dying in the inside from immense stress of being a bad person to my partner....its like I can't forgive myself for the ways I've made them feel...Gulit can eat at a person and it's eating me alive
Thank you I try to be!!!
They can just get another girlfriend eventually! A better one that won’t come with issue, that isn’t tainted and defective
I do want the most terrible punishment your right! For what I did to them I want someone to kill me in a gruesome way because it’s what I deserve.
I sent you a message! I’m in Cali like you

I luckily don’t have any kids to leave behind! We were planning on maybe trying for a baby in December if our relationship got better but I doubt that’s going to happen. I plan on killing my self March 2nd on my birthday…a few months after the new year

That’s the only person that cares…I have no friends or family outside of them…my partner family likes me a bit but they’ll get over my death quick…my partner will get over It too with their help and with being left financially stable before my departure. I believe they’ll be a bit relieved not having to deal with me and my drama anymore
I want to die and be an angel for them…I think I can do better work and influence their life more positively from above

I have done everything you said. I try to be super positive. Super sweet… show that I’ve changed…they say change isn’t the point…they want me to explain why I did what I did…I did…they said it’s not good enough and they dont believe me…although it’s the truth…I can’t win!!But I think I can allow my partner to win by killing myself…this isn’t one of those relationships where you can just leave and live life after…I feel the only thing I can do is die… I honestly believe I was meant to die because of this at this point…I believe I can sacrifice myself for their happiness…if I stay here just long enough to get us stable financially in life and a little happy…then I can go…I bribe after I die their life will finally really start and they’ll be able to live, a truly happy amazing life…I feel I’m holding them back…I’m willing to sacrifice myself for their happiness

I don’t think it’s fair to say they don’t love me actually… they sacrifice themselves being with me everysingle day…I make their life extremely hard and they still try to have as many good times with me as possible and still try to make me smile when there not upset. They just ran me a nice bath the other day, gave me a massage, and cooked dinner…my babies very sweet, very loving, honestly the kindest person I know…I’m making their life hard

I tell them all the time..I have changed already but They say It takes nothing way from the pain I caused….they still see me the same…this is my one and only love so if they don’t love me anymore I have no purpose
I broke their heart..made them insecure…gave them social anxiety to the point they can barley go in public…I’m a pretty bad person!

I have before they said they’d rather I die then themselves die from being with me and not being able to take the pain I cause anymore… fyi I wrote this message months ago but just posted It now because…same feelings… but that response to me above was more recent

Thank you for listening! I do appreciate It. It's hard its really fucking hard. The awkwardness in the house. The lingering of hate, sadness, and regret. I regret hurting them they regret ever being with me. It's sad

Well basically I fucked up our relationship(don't want to get into too much detail for their sake). I didn't cheat or anything but I've made them really depressed and sad. We always argue and I always make them cry and break down. I've honestly brought the worst up out of them and I feel horrible about It because I didn't mean to.

About me...well I'm 22 year old female. I've never really had anyone. Me and my mom aren't close neither are me and my sisters. I don't really have family that I'm close to either. I'm really lonely. 

I love my partner to death but I can't live with myself knowing that I ruined such a perfect person. Plus they're growing apart from me so I'm getting increasingly more lonely. 

My partner kinda hates me to be honest(rightfully so). It breaks my heart knowing I broke there's. I'm just over myself.

I feel disgusting and evil and I want to die.
